actions.title: Run a scan
actions.confirmScanMsg: Compare your mutual list and each tracked person's subscriptions.
actions.confirmResumeMsg: A previous scan was interrupted. Instree will continue where it left off (draft and partial snapshots kept).
actions.confirmBaselineMsg: Clears scan history and cached snapshots, then re-fetches every watched mutual. Very slow, many API calls. The new scan becomes the only reference (#1).
webSchedule.title: Automatic scan
webSchedule.hint: Scan every night at {hour}:00 ({tz}). Manual scans are disabled on the server.
webSchedule.baselinePending: Baseline pending — configure your Instagram session in Settings to start it automatically.
webSchedule.baselineInProgress: Baseline in progress — history will update when it finishes.
settings.sessionHint: Paste the two codes from Instagram (in your browser), then click “Check connection”. On this computer, Instree can also read them from Chrome, Edge, or Firefox.
settings.mutualsHint: Instree tracks people you follow who also follow you back (mutual friends). Enter a number, or MAX for everyone.
settings.mutualsCount: How many mutual friends to analyze
settings.watchN: How many of their follows to check
settings.watchNHint: MAX = all of their follows. A number (e.g. 100) = only the most recent ones.
settings.watchFollowingHint: If unchecked: Instree only looks at your mutual friends list (faster, no graph).
settings.refetchMutualsHint: If unchecked: Instree reuses the known list when nothing changed on Instagram.
settings.skipUnchangedHint: If unchecked: Instree re-checks every friend on each run (slower, safer).
settings.partialFetchHint: If unchecked: when someone changed, Instree re-downloads their full list (slower).
settings.maxPersonFollowingHint: Avoids downloading huge lists. MAX = no limit.
settings.pageSize: How much to ask Instagram each time
settings.pageSizeHint: Between 12 and 200. Lower = slower but safer. Instagram may return less.
settings.scheduleIntervalHint: Set 0 to turn off. Example: 60 = one automatic analysis every hour while Instree is open.
settings.autostartOnBoot: Open Instree when the computer starts
settings.autostartHint: Instree starts by itself when you turn on your PC, so automatic analyses can keep running.
settings.portHint: 127.0.0.1 = this computer only. If you change the port, restart Instree.
settings.sessionKeep: Already saved — leave empty to keep it
settings.sessionPaste: Paste your Instagram login code here
lang.label: Language
graph.searchNotFound: Person not found in the graph.
graph.searchHidden: Found but hidden by filters — show their group again.
